OATHBOUND: Heroes of the Shattered Realm

OATHBOUND brings together warriors, mages, and creatures of an ancient pact — the raw force of barbarians alongside the discipline of knights, and the silent cunning of assassins and witches.

Thirteen characters, one oath. Names below are placeholders — send the real ones whenever you have them.

WWII: The Endless Battle

Twelve command and armor sculptures covering three fronts of the Second World War: the Red Army, the Allied forces, and the Axis — each officer and vehicle modeled with close historical attention to detail.

Collection inspired by the WWII: War Machines and Commanders campaign.

The Seven Sins

Seven sculptures, each one the portrait of a deadly sin taken to the extreme: bodies carrying the weight of their own vice, from Gluttony's endless feast to Sloth's eternal rest.

One sculpture per sin. No redemption included.
